name: From Pilot to Production: A Leader’s Playbook for AWS AI at Scale
description:
# [From Pilot to Production: A Leader’s Playbook for AWS AI at Scale](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/from-pilot-to-production-a-leaders-playbook-for-aws-ai-at-scale?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=aws_fy26_q4&utm_term=sp)

AI investments are growing, but how many are actually delivering measurable business results? For enterprises, the real competitive advantage lies not in building AI pilots, but in turning them into scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency, accelerate decision-making, and drive business growth.

Join us for a business-focused session on how enterprise leaders can move AI initiatives beyond experimentation and into production using AWS.
**Schedule:**
**Date**: Nov 12th, 2026
**Time:** 12 PM EDT
**Where**: **[Register Now](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/from-pilot-to-production-a-leaders-playbook-for-aws-ai-at-scale?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=aws_fy26_q4&utm_term=sp)**[ ](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/from-pilot-to-production-a-leaders-playbook-for-aws-ai-at-scale?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=aws_fy26_q4&utm_term=sp)

Understand the key considerations for scaling enterprise AI, including security, governance, operational readiness, scalability, and aligning AI investments with measurable business outcomes.

**Who should attend?**
CIOs, CTOs, IT Directors, VPs of Engineering, AI/ML Leaders, Cloud Architects, Enterprise Architects, and technology decision-makers.

See you in the session!

name: From AI Pilot to Production on Google Cloud
description:

This webinar will explore how Google Cloud can help organizations overcome these challenges and turn AI initiatives into solutions that deliver real business value.

name: Doing More with Limited Resources: Prioritizing Public Sector AI Projects
description:
Learn how to balance innovation with governance, risk management, and accountability while building a practical roadmap for AI adoption that delivers measurable results.
This session explores how government and public sector professionals can move from scattered AI experimentation to a focused project strategy. Discover practical ways to assess opportunities, allocate resources, manage risks, and build an AI roadmap that connects innovation with better public services.
📅 **Wednesday, November 18, 2026**
🕒 **10:00 AM EST**
🔗 **[CLICK HERE TO REGISTER](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/public-sector-ai-projects?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=pmi_fy26_q4&utm_content=master_classes&utm_term=mup_18)**

## WHY ATTEND?

AI adoption across government is growing, but turning experimentation into measurable public impact remains a significant challenge. This masterclass will help you understand how to move beyond AI experimentation and make more informed decisions about which projects to pursue, how to allocate resources, and how to measure success.

## WHAT YOU’LL LEARN

* **Prioritize High-Value AI Projects:** Evaluate initiatives based on public value, feasibility, expected impact, and organizational priorities.
* **Understand the AI Project Lifecycle:** Explore the journey from business understanding and project planning to deployment.
* **Address Data and Governance Challenges:** Identify data readiness requirements, governance considerations, and responsible AI risks.
* **Optimize Limited Resources:** Align budgets, teams, and technology with initiatives that offer measurable outcomes.
* **Build a Practical AI Roadmap:** Develop a structured approach to prioritizing and delivering AI projects that improve public services.
* **Join Live Discussions and Q&A:** Explore practical challenges and get your questions answered.

## ADD VALUE TO YOUR PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT

* **Earn 1 PDU:** Receive 1 Professional Development Unit toward your professional development and PMI certification requirements.
* **Learn from Industry Experience:** Gain insights from 20+ years of industry expertise across Reliance, Flipkart, and professional training.
* **Explore Practical Project Management:** Apply proven project management practices through real-world insights and examples from complex business environments.

See you in the session! 😊
